question: Who assumed the role of the Election Commissioner in the Election Commission of India on 15 March 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukhbir Singh Sandhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu** was appointed as an **Election Commissioner in the Election Commission of India** on **15 March 2024**.
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is a constitutional body responsible for administering elections to the Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President of India.
 
• As an Election Commissioner, **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu** will play a key role in ensuring free, fair, and transparent elections.
 
• The appointment of Election Commissioners is made by the President of India under Article **324** of the Constitution of India.
 
• Prior to his appointment, **Sukhbir Singh Sandhu** has held various administrative positions and is known for his expertise in public administration and governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The **Election Commission of India** was established on **25 January 1950** under Article **324** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is an independent constitutional authority responsible for conducting elections in India.
 
• The ECI consists of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and **two Election Commissioners**.
 
• The Commission functions as a watchdog to ensure free and fair elections, preventing malpractices and enforcing election laws.
 
 
 
• **Appointment of Election Commissioners:**
 
 
• The **President of India** appoints the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners.
 
• They serve a tenure of **6 years** or until the age of **65**, whichever is earlier.
 
• Their independence is safeguarded by provisions ensuring their removal only through a process similar to that for Supreme Court judges.
 
 
 
• **Responsibilities of Election Commissioners:**
 
 
• They oversee the preparation of electoral rolls and conduct elections for the **Parliament, State Legislatures, and the President and Vice-President of India**.
 
• The Commission ensures compliance with the **Representation of People Act** and other election-related laws.
 
• They also address disputes related to recognition of political parties and allocation of election symbols.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments:**
 
 
• The Commission has been adopting advanced technologies like **Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs)** and **Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT)** systems to enhance transparency.
 
• It has also introduced measures like **Model Code of Conduct** to ensure ethical practices during elections.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 324:**

 
 
• It vests the **superintendence, direction, and control** of elections in the Election Commission of India.
 
• The Article provides the framework for the functioning and authority of the Election Commission.
 
 
 
• **Representation of People Act, 1951:**
 
 
• This Act governs the conduct of elections and outlines procedures for qualifications and disqualifications of members.
 
• It also specifies the rules regarding corrupt practices and electoral offenses.
 
 
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner vs Election Commissioners:**
 
 
• While the CEC holds the highest authority within the Election Commission, decisions are generally taken collectively by all members.
 
• In case of a disagreement, the majority view prevails.
